fields.description: Save magic 'A2M1' at start of 16-byte EEPROM header.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d85c copies the 4-byte magic from ROM into header+0; FUN_0800d9d8/FUN_0800d904 checksum and validate it. Logical (rev8) bytes at file offset 0 are 41 32 4D 31 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Index of the most recently saved/loaded file slot (0-3).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800da9c stores the saved slot id at save-RAM header+6 (iVar1-0xe); FUN_0800da38 stores the loaded slot id at the same header+6 (iVar2-10). Baseline value 0 selects slot 0 at file offset 0x10.
fields.name: last_used_slot

fields.description: Bitmask of file slots holding saved data; bit s corresponds to slot s.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800da9c sets bit s at save-RAM header+7 (iVar1-0xd) on save; FUN_0800d93c clears bit s there on slot init; FUN_0800d85c/FUN_08032018/FUN_080322ec test (header+7 >> slot) & 1 to detect an empty slot. Baseline 0x00.
fields.name: slot_present_flags

fields.description: Chapter/area selector for slot 0; primary input of the chapter-glyph mapper.
fields.evidence: FUN_08032018 and FUN_080322ec read save-RAM slot+0x43 (file offset 0x53 for slot 0) as the first argument of FUN_08032394, which maps it to chapter glyphs '1'-'5' via thresholds 10/0x1F/0x2E/0x43/0x52. Baseline 0x00 maps to chapter '1'.
fields.name: slot0_chapter_key

fields.description: Stage/world sub-index for slot 0; second input of the chapter-glyph mapper.
fields.evidence: FUN_08032018 and FUN_080322ec read save-RAM slot+0x2C (file offset 0x3C for slot 0) as the second argument of FUN_08032394 (values 1-4 select glyphs when chapter key is 10). Init default 0xFF via FUN_0800d93c (*(u16*)(slot+0x2C) = 0xFF).
fields.name: slot0_stage_index

fields.description: Save/progress mode byte for slot 0: 0 = fresh default, 10 = new game, 1 = continued.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800dcc8 writes param value 10 to working-buffer+0x2F (file offset 0x3F) on the new-game path from FUN_0800e888; FUN_0800dbf0 branches on this byte being 0 vs 1 when loading progress. Baseline 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_save_mode

fields.description: Collectible/event flag bits for slot 0; flag id n sets bit (n-1)%8 of byte (n-1)/8 from this base.
fields.evidence: FUN_080323e0 tests bit (1 << ((id-1)%8)) at save-RAM slot+0x4F + (id-1)/8 (file offset 0x5F for slot 0, ids 1-8). Baseline 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_collect_flags

fields.description: Game-state counter A for slot 0; initialized to 3600 (0x0E10).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d93c sets *(u16*)(slot+0x28) = 0x0E10 (file offset 0x38, bytes 10 0E in baseline). No gameplay reader identified; value mirrors 1:1 between save RAM and EEPROM via FUN_0800da9c/FUN_0800cca8.
fields.name: slot0_counter_a

fields.description: Game-state counter B for slot 0; initialized to 3600 (0x0E10).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d93c sets *(u16*)(slot+0x2A) = 0x0E10 (file offset 0x3A, bytes 10 0E in baseline). No gameplay reader identified; value mirrors 1:1 between save RAM and EEPROM via FUN_0800da9c/FUN_0800cca8.
fields.name: slot0_counter_b
